name: Any other place (generic fallback)
notice: Illustrative example only, not legal advice. Knotwork does not know the current rules, forms, fees or waiting times of any agency; check each office's own instructions before you go. The 'from' day on each step is a planning placeholder counted from your wedding date, not a processing time.

artifacts.label: Certified copy of your marriage certificate
A current photo ID in your previous name
Your new Social Security card (or the agency's confirmation)
Your updated driver's license or state ID
Your current passport, or another proof of citizenship

steps.title: Update your name with the Social Security Administration
steps.notes: Usually the first step: other offices often look for the updated federal record. Illustrative; ask the agency what it currently needs.

steps.title: Update your driver's license or state ID
steps.notes: At your state's motor vehicle office. Illustrative; states differ in what they ask for.

steps.title: Update the name on your vehicle title and registration
steps.notes: Often handled by the same office as the license, sometimes by another. Illustrative.

steps.title: Update your passport
steps.notes: Illustrative; which form applies depends on how recently your passport was issued. Check the official instructions.

steps.title: Tell your employer's payroll and benefits team
steps.notes: So your pay records match the federal record.

steps.title: Update your bank and card accounts
steps.notes: Many banks ask to see the updated ID and the certificate.

steps.title: Update insurance, utilities, medical and other accounts
steps.notes: Work down your own list; most only need a call or a form.
